title: A look at potential Nvidia CEO candidates, including CFO Colette Kress, CUDA inventor Ian Buck, Arm CEO Rene Haas, and Apple Chief Hardware Officer Johny Srouji (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: A look at potential Nvidia CEO candidates, including CFO Colette Kress, CUDA inventor Ian Buck, Arm CEO Rene Haas, and Apple Chief Hardware Officer Johny Srouji — Nvidia Corp. is searching for a replacement for larger-than-life Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, a daunting challenge at the world's most valuable chipmaker.
